_note: VERIFIED CANON of official UK reporting / consumer-protection routes. Single source of truth for: (1) the accuracy gate's allowed phone numbers (content_gate.py derives ALLOWED_PHONE_DIGITS from the phone/sms fields in official_routes AND the phone field in verified_org_contacts), (2) the gate's reporting-email validation (check_sources), and (3) build.py's on-page 'Report this scam' block. NEVER hardcode an org number or reporting route anywhere else. Verify any change against the official source before committing. Phones are normalised to digits-only by the gate. verified_org_contacts is SEPARATE from official_routes: it holds a company's own published support/fraud line, verified against that company's own site, so a guide can name it without the gate treating it as invented. These are NOT national reporting routes and are never rendered in build.py's 'Report this scam' block. Every entry needs source_url + checked_on and must be re-verified quarterly — commercial numbers change far more often than official ones. Prefer telling readers to use the number on their bill/card/official site; only add an entry when naming the number genuinely helps.

official_routes.name: Police Scotland non-emergency reporting (Scotland)

official_routes.name: Citizens Advice consumer helpline (England and Wales)
Stop Scams UK — call your bank
Victim Support England and Wales Supportline
Advice Direct Scotland consumer helpline (Scotland)
official_routes.note: TWO GOV.UK pages print DIFFERENT Advice Direct Scotland numbers, which read as a contradiction until you look at what each serves (operator review, 2026-07-29). Resolved 2026-07-30: both are genuine and belong to the same charity. gov.uk/consumer-advice lists 0808 800 9060 (advice.scot, the general advice line, named there for consumer issues); gov.uk/consumer-protection-rights lists 0808 164 6000, which gov.scot confirms is the separate Scottish-Government-funded consumeradvice.scot service run by Advice Direct Scotland — see the advice-direct-scotland-consumeradvice entry below. THIS entry stays the canon on-page consumer route for Scotland because it is the one GOV.UK's dedicated consumer-advice page names.

official_routes.name: consumeradvice.scot consumer helpline (Advice Direct Scotland, Scotland)
official_routes.note: Advice Direct Scotland's dedicated consumer-advice service, funded by the Scottish Government. Recorded so the number is not treated as invented if a guide cites the GOV.UK consumer-protection-rights page, and so the two numbers can never again look like a canon error. NOT on_page: the sidebar carries one consumer route per nation, and that is advice-direct-scotland. Verified against two GOV.UK pages and gov.scot's launch announcement; advice.scot and consumeradvice.scot could not be fetched directly on 2026-07-30 (TLS chain error from this toolchain), so the service split rests on GOV.UK plus gov.scot rather than the charity's own page. Re-verify at the next quarterly canon check.

verified_org_contacts.name: TalkTalk customer support
verified_org_contacts.note: Main TalkTalk support line (account, billing, technical). Text Relay: 18001 0345 172 0088. Used by guides/talktalk-scam-call-uk to tell readers to hang up and call TalkTalk back on its published number.

verified_org_contacts.name: HMRC phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: GOV.UK: "Forward suspicious text messages to 60599" and "Forward suspicious emails to HMRC's phishing team: phishing@hmrc.gov.uk then delete them." This is HMRC's OWN reporting route, not a national one — 7726 remains the network shortcode for forwarding scam texts generally, and this never appears in the on-page 'Report this scam' block. Quoted from the primary page on 2026-07-31.

verified_org_contacts.name: NatWest scam-text reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: NatWest: "Forward any suspicious texts to us at 88355… This is not a premium rate number. Standard network rates apply." The bank's OWN route, not a national one — 7726 remains the network shortcode. Surfaced by the new check_shortcodes() gate and verified against the primary page on 2026-07-31.

verified_org_contacts.name: HSBC UK phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: HSBC UK tells customers to forward a suspicious email or text to this address. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Santander UK phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Santander's own how-to-report-fraud page names this for suspicious EMAILS. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Santander UK smishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Same page names a SEPARATE address for suspicious TEXTS, alongside 7726. Two addresses for one bank is deliberate, not a duplicate. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: NatWest phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: NatWest: forward a fraudulent or suspicious email here if you have not replied to it. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Nationwide phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Nationwide takes suspicious emails, texts and messages at this address. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: TSB scam-email reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: TSB takes forwarded scam emails AND screenshots of scam texts at this address. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Amazon scam reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Amazon's own 'Report a scam' help page. Amazon asks for the suspicious message as an ATTACHMENT so it can be traced, and does not reply personally. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Royal Mail scam reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Royal Mail takes forwarded suspicious emails here, and a SCREENSHOT for suspicious texts. For calls or websites it asks for the number or address in the body. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: PayPal phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: PayPal asks you to FORWARD the email, explicitly NOT as an attachment and without altering the subject line, so the source tracking data survives — the opposite of Amazon's and Apple's instructions, so the guides must not generalise. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Apple phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Apple takes forwarded phishing emails, and a SCREENSHOT for suspicious texts. It asks for full header information (Forward As Attachment in macOS Mail). Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: EE phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: EE's own avoid-and-prevent-scams page. It also tells customers to delete the message after reporting. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Vodafone UK phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Vodafone's page obfuscates the address with Cloudflare email protection, so it was read by DECODING the published cfemail payload rather than copied from a search summary. Vodafone also lists an anti-fraud line, 0333 304 1665, for account fraud. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Virgin Media phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: TWO ADDRESSES EXIST. virginmedia.com/help/security — the support page — names phishing@virginmedia.com as primary, which is what the guides use. Virgin Media O2's editorial pages also name phishing@virginmediao2.com after the merger. Both are the same company; finding the O2 one elsewhere is NOT evidence this is stale. Recorded so a future audit does not re-raise it, as happened with Advice Direct Scotland. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: TalkTalk phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: TalkTalk's help centre. Distinct from the TalkTalk SUPPORT line already in this list under key `talktalk`. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: British Gas phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: British Gas asks for the suspicious email ATTACHED to a new message, and a SCREENSHOT for suspicious texts. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Netflix phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Netflix takes forwarded suspicious emails AND texts at the same address. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Student Loans Company phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: GOV.UK's student-finance phishing guidance: send a suspected scam email or text here. This REPLACED phishing@slc.co.uk, which the guides carried until 2026-07-31 and which no prior audit caught. SLC also lists furtherinfo@slc.co.uk for suspected vishing calls — a separate route, not an alternative to this one. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Yodel suspicious-email reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Yodel by InPost's fraud page. Distinct from the SENDING addresses it publishes (donotreply@ / noreply@yodel.co.uk), which the guides quote so readers recognise genuine mail and which are NOT reporting routes. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Microsoft phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: For email clients other than Outlook. Microsoft requires the message as an ATTACHMENT in a NEW email — explicitly not forwarded — so the headers survive. In Outlook itself the Report button is the faster route. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Depop phishing reporting
verified_org_contacts.note: Depop asks for the email forwarded WITH the sender's information. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.

verified_org_contacts.name: Revolut support inbox (fallback reporting route)
verified_org_contacts.note: A SUPPORT inbox, not a dedicated phishing address. Revolut directs fraud reports to in-app chat first and names this only for customers who cannot reach the app or chat — which is exactly how the guide uses it. Revolut offers no general phone support, so an inbound call claiming to be Revolut is itself a red flag. Verified against the organisation's own published page on 2026-07-31; re-verify quarterly.
